missions.title: Starting Point
missions.description: "I have no eyes for this. All Griffin forces are retreating. Leaving her here would only mean certain death for her. What do you think...?"

missions.title: Splinter Point
missions.description: "Where...exactly am I...?"

missions.title: Exhaust I
missions.description: "Ange, we've retrieved M4A1. Any further instructions?"

missions.title: Exhaust II
missions.description: "Griffin is moving into Area S11? I see. So it's turning into a shitshow here."

missions.title: Exhaust III
missions.description: "I'm receiving a transmission request with AK-12's plain code. Should I take it?"

missions.title: Exhaust IV
missions.description: "We have paid a huge price, but that should be enough to safeguard the route to the rendezvous point."

missions.title: Compression I
missions.description: "You do remember that this is your forte, don't you, AK-12?

missions.title: Compression II
missions.description: "Just a simple disconnection was enough to completely scramble her neural cloud... She's too mentally fragile even for an old model..."

missions.title: Compression III
missions.description: "Are you really okay with leaving all these enemies to her alone?"

missions.title: Compression IV
missions.description: "That'll be enough, M4. These are allies. Members of Task Force DEFY, Ange and AN-94.

missions.title: Ignition I
missions.description: "Thanks for the hard work! Please stay at your posts, account for all our injured, and await new directives from the Commander!"

missions.title: Ignition II
missions.description: "Still no way of contacting the Commander? What about the Military? Nothing either?"

missions.title: Ignition III
missions.description: "...That's all we know about the situation in Area S09."

missions.title: Ignition IV
missions.description: "Commander, we've successfully brought back the T-Dolls on the other side!"

missions.title: Splinter Point
missions.description: "...Yes. We must...prevent the Military from acquiring the Mastermind at all costs."

missions.title: Queen's Gambit I
missions.description: "Is it going well, Ange?"

missions.title: Queen's Gambit II
missions.description: "Persica, you must stop what you're doing right now."

missions.title: Queen's Gambit III
missions.description: "Persica, I've already ordered them to drop everything and have AK-12 and AN-94 prepare for electronic warfare."

missions.title: Queen's Gambit IV
missions.description: "Comms are back up... Not sure if that's good news or bad news..."

missions.title: Castling I
missions.description: "I'm guessing you're not gonna let this go, are you?"

missions.title: Castling II
missions.description: "I'm back. Things really aren't looking good... After all, these are the Military's main forces..."

missions.title: Castling III
missions.description: "I'm curious. Were you disappointed at all...when Ange told us our rescue target is Squad 404?"

missions.title: Castling IV
missions.description: "Agent, M4A1 has returned and established contact with Squad 404, currently located in the large database."

missions.title: Promotion I
missions.description: "45, Griffin forces will arrive in three minutes."

missions.title: Promotion II
missions.description: "Have we all got enough rest, girls? Let's get cracking then."

missions.title: Promotion III
missions.description: "45, their firepower is way too much!"

missions.title: Promotion IV
missions.description: "Is our backup still not here? If we fall back any farther, we'll have to use the Sangvis database as cover."

missions.title: Weakling's End I
missions.description: "Emergency, Commander! We've discovered Sangvis elite Gager's forces on our retreat!"

missions.title: Weakling's End II
missions.description: "It's coming back to me... All the things that happened..."

missions.title: Weakling's End III
missions.description: "So...what do we do now?"

missions.title: Weakling's End IV
missions.description: "It's my honor, mighty Commander of Griffin, to meet an adversary like you on the battlefield...and tear you apart with my own hands."

missions.title: Last Resort I
missions.description: "Wake up, M4. Mission is go."

missions.title: Last Resort II
missions.description: "Remaining Sangvis units all eradicated."

missions.title: Last Resort III
missions.description: "I'm sure you, too, understand that things are pretty critical. Just killing Sangvis forces won't be enough to stop the Military."

missions.title: Last Resort IV
missions.description: "You're finally here."

missions.title: Last Resort V
missions.description: "Can you hold it any longer, Squad 404?!"

missions.title: Endgame
missions.description: "The Military units have all frozen... Are they too close to the explosion?"

missions.title: Messenger
missions.description: "My, you're the Commander?!"

missions.title: Survivor
missions.description: "Hmm, the Commander is here... Thank you for giving me the chance to regroup with G3."

missions.title: Goodbye, Dragon Palace
missions.description: "The Military, Sangvis Ferri, Griffin...and some unknown forces. What a mess."

missions.title: Hornet's Nest
missions.description: "Oh dear... Is that where they're aiming this time? Those big boys seriously wanna level our home, don't they?"

missions.title: Endgame
missions.description: "Before reaching our destination, we have to... Mastermind...where?!"
